values.note: recreation.gov rate table, 2026 and 2027 peak seasons and the first-come off-seasons alike: standard non-electric $26, standard electric $31; tent-only and walk-to sites $22, group tent sites $50. A Sleeping Bear Dunes entrance pass is required for every vehicle using the campground, separate from the camping fee: private vehicle $25 for 1-7 days, park annual pass $45; America the Beautiful passes are honored for entry. The Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid. $20 no-show fee.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232458/rates ('Peak Season 2026-05-01 - 2026-10-31' and 2027: 'PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC 26', 'PeakSTANDARD ELECTRIC 31') + https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/platterivercamp.htm ('A park pass is required for all vehicles using the campground, including those who are visiting campers') + https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/fees.htm ('Private Vehicle $25.00 Entrance pass - vehicle 1-7 day') + rec.gov notice ('The Michigan Recreation Passport is not valid for entry'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/platterivercamp.htm ('Platte River Campground is open year-round for your camping enjoyment') + rec.gov overview ('This year-round facility'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Regular sites are reserved on recreation.gov up to 6 months ahead for May 1 through October 31 (group sites up to a year); November-April the campground is first come, first served at the same rates. Bookable through the day before arrival. 14-night limit, and 14 total days per campground between Memorial Day weekend and Labor Day. Check in at the campground office on arrival; call 231-326-4700 ext. 5029 if arriving more than 24 hours late. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon. Generators prohibited.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/platterivercamp.htm ('Regular sites may be reserved up to 6 months in advance for May 1 through October 31. Groups sites may be reserved up to a year in advance') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232458 (rate seasons 'First-come, First-served Season' Nov 1-Apr 30; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 0; permit conditions 1-3, 7, 17), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 171 bookable sites: 90 standard electric (RVs to 20-40 ft, most 30-35 ft), 50 standard non-electric (15-35 ft), 1 RV non-electric, 25 tent-only/walk-to and 5 group tent sites; 11 pull-throughs.

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232458 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: site types and 'Max Vehicle Length', 'Driveway Entry' Pull-Through on 11 sites) + rec.gov description ('back-in and pull-through sites with electric hookups for RVs, non-electric sites, walk-to sites, group sites'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232458 ('Each loop has restrooms with flush toilets and sinks. Hot showers are also available'; permit condition 15 'Containers must be kept under drains and emptied only at the dump station'), read 2026-10-22

summary: NPS page and recreation.gov (NPS-operated, not a concession): $26 non-electric / $31 electric for 2026 and 2027 (confirmed), entrance pass required for every vehicle ($25/7 days; Recreation Passport not valid) recorded in fees.note; campground is open year-round (season 05-01..10-31 -> year_round; reservations May-Oct up to 6 months ahead, FCFS Nov-Apr); 14-night max; 171 bookable sites to 40 ft with 11 pull-throughs, 30/50-amp electric, no water hookups; showers, flush toilets, dump. Phone 231-326-4700 matches. The --AWH note is consistent with the pages and left untouched. NPS alerts API was rate-limited (DEMO_KEY), but the park's conditions page (https://www.nps.gov/slbe/planyourvisit/conditions.htm) and the rec.gov notices show no closure at Platte River.
